actProfiles._noteProfile: act-profile-v1 (2026-10-21): statusChange = who decided the current Suspendat / Retras / Anulat status and why ({ initiator: titular | autoritate, reason, decision, dosarId? }, the date is the status date: suspensionDate / withdrawalDate / cancellationDate); dossierNr + requestSubmitted = the issuing request when it is not in „Solicitările mele” (filed before GEAP v2 or by someone else); specificFields = the configured act fields (AC-29), shown on the profile as „Ce permite actul”
actProfiles._noteTypeFirst: type-first-v1 (2026-10-21): more act types for the same place (Cafeneaua „Izvoraș” — alcohol, fire safety) and one act without a location (the transport licence) — data/acte-permisive.json › intent.acts
